collins.quote: So, as I have said from the beginning, I support an extension of the ACA tax credits, but they need reform.
collins.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Order of Procedure
collins.why: She voted to extend the enhanced premium tax credits (Dec. 11, 2025). Her vote the other way (Jan. 13, 2026) was on the 2025 marketplace enrollment rules, not the credits, and in September 2026 she voted to take up a resolution overturning those rules.

collins.quote: I support a woman's right to have an abortion, and I believe that the threshold question of whether abortion is legal needs to be consistent at the national level.
collins.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Statements on Introduced Bills and Joint Resolutions
collins.why: She voted for the Reproductive Freedom for Women Act (2024) and against extending the ban on Medicaid payments to abortion providers (2026). Her one vote the other way, on the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act (2025), sets care rules for infants born alive after an attempted abortion rather than limiting the right itself.

collins.quote: I support a woman's right to have an abortion, and I believe that the threshold question of whether or not abortion is legal needs to be consistent at the national level.
collins.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Statements on Introduced Bills and Joint Resolutions
collins.why: She cosponsored the Reproductive Freedom for All Act (2023), voted for the Reproductive Freedom for Women Act (2024) and voted against extending the ban on Medicaid payments to abortion providers (2026). Her one vote the other way, on the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act (2025), sets care rules for infants born alive after an attempted abortion rather than limiting the right itself.

collins.quote: I support funding for better border security, including physical barriers where they make sense.

collins.why: She voted for 5 of the 6 border-security amendments in 2021–22 and for the 2026 Secure America Act. The votes the other way were a February 2021 budget amendment and cloture on the 2024 Border Act.
